decision_rules: Never infer market closure from absent saved candles.
Provider-observed HLC does not prove execution availability or every underlying quote.
A no-order interval is not automatically a no-quote interval.
Require feed/instrument/environment/effective-domain mapping before slot classification changes.
Keep UNKNOWN for unqualified slots; never fill missing prices or turn unknown outcomes into FLAT.
Any future calendar-driven functional/mask change needs its own source-bound generation and matched fresh qualification.
